title: Northeast Kingdom Byway
direction: Follows the mapped byway from Newport to St. Johnsbury.

sources.driveTimes: OSRM (router.project-osrm.org), OpenStreetMap data, computed at build time; excludes stops and traffic

moments.title: Lyndon
moments.text: A town of covered bridges over the branches of the Passumpsic, the Randall from 1865 and the Sanborn from 1867 among them, the Sanborn standing between Lyndon and St. Johnsbury.

moments.title: Newport
moments.text: First called Pickeral Point, then Lake Bridge, the city wraps the south shore of Lake Memphremagog, where the Clyde, Barton and Black rivers all come in.
